import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import diskusage

entries = [
    ("src/app.py", 1200),
    ("src/util.PY", 300),
    ("README", 80),
    (".gitignore", 12),
    ("docs/.hidden.md", 5),
    ("docs/guide.md", 4096),
    ("archive.tar.gz", 100000),
    ("a/b/c/Makefile", 640),
]
print(sorted(diskusage.count_by_extension(path for path, _ in entries).items()))
print(sorted(diskusage.size_by_extension(entries).items()))
print(diskusage.count_by_extension([]), diskusage.size_by_extension([]))
print("ok")
